map.t = 容量(Wh) / 功耗(W): t = capacity in Wh / power draw in W
map.移动机器人续航估算。: Estimating the endurance of mobile robots.
map.任务规划电源匹配。: Matching the power supply to the mission plan.
map.t=Ah·V/P=2×12/24=1h；电池能量 24Wh 供 24W 负载可用: t = Ah·V/P = 2 x 12/24 = 1 h; a 24 Wh battery feeding a 24 W load lasts one hour.
map.t=24/12=2h，功耗减半续航翻倍。: t = 24/12 = 2 h; halving the power draw doubles the runtime.
map.能量 Wh=Ah×V；续航=Wh/P。: Energy in Wh = Ah x V, and the runtime is Wh/P.
map.会；放电倍率、温度、老化使可用容量低于标称。: Yes. Discharge rate, temperature and ageing all make the usable capacity fall below the nominal figure.
